name: hanging-context
description: News stories designed for AI agents serving professionals across finance, technology and more. Every fact links to its sources. Read-only. No sign-in.

interface.longDescription:
News stories designed for AI agents serving professionals across finance, technology and more. Every fact in a story links to its sources. Stories are rebuilt every 12 hours from source material published in the last 24 hours.

Topics: artificial intelligence (models and labs, developer tools, funding and deals, research, chips and infrastructure, policy), finance and investing, sports, health and biotech, research and science, the US federal government, state legislatures and governors, energy and climate, and business podcasts.

With Hanging Context you can:
- Ask a question and get matching facts, quoted word for word, each with a link to its story.
- See the latest stories, for all topics or for one topic.
- Search recent stories by keyword.
- Read a whole story.
- See the sources behind a story: title, publisher, date and original link.
- Get only the stories that are new since you last checked.

Before a story is published, each quote is checked to appear word for word in a cited source. A story that fails a check is not published.

Hanging Context reads only its own published stories. It needs no account, does not use your chat history and changes nothing. Search uses keyword matching, so results depend on the words you use. It does not cover news less than about 12 hours old or sources behind a paywall.
capabilities: Get new stories since last check
defaultPrompt: What are the latest AI stories on Hanging Context?
What did the Federal Reserve say recently, per Hanging Context? Cite the sources.
Which sources does the newest Hanging Context AI story use?

positive.prompt: Show me the two latest health and biotech stories from Hanging Context.
positive.expected_behavior: Two health and biotech stories, newest first, each with headline, summary and story link.

positive.prompt: According to Hanging Context, what did the Federal Reserve say recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Up to 5 facts quoted from Hanging Context stories about the Federal Reserve, each with a link to its story. No invented facts.

positive.prompt: Search Hanging Context for news about OpenAI.
positive.expected_behavior: Stories that mention OpenAI in the headline, summary or body, each with headline and link; or a clear message that none match.

positive.prompt: Which sources does the newest Hanging Context AI story use?
positive.expected_behavior: The newest AI story, then its sources with title, publisher, original URL and date.

positive.prompt: What topics does Hanging Context cover? Then open the newest sports story.
positive.expected_behavior: The topic list, then the newest sports story with its key facts and link.

negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Creative writing needs no news tool
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about autumn.
Set a reminder for 9 am tomorrow.

review.commerce_description: Hanging Context does not sell anything or process payments.
